features.name: bid_count
features.description: Total number of bids submitted by the bidder across all tenders.

features.name: win_rate
features.description: Ratio of awarded bids to total submitted bids (0.0 to 1.0).

features.name: shared_address_count
features.description: Count of distinct bidders sharing registered business address.

features.name: shared_director_count
features.description: Count of distinct bidders sharing common corporate directors.

features.name: shared_bank_account_count
features.description: Count of distinct bidders sharing identical bank account identifiers.

features.name: verification_mismatch_count
features.description: Count of government verification API mismatches (GST/MCA/PAN).

features.name: document_contradiction_count
features.description: Count of cross-document financial or identifier contradictions.

features.name: compliance_failure_count
features.description: Count of failed mandatory tender requirements.

features.name: network_centrality
features.description: Degree/Betweenness network centrality score within entity graph.
